messages.subject: Postdoctoral position in Alzheimer's epidemiology and clinical trials modelling
parts:
Hello Stan users,

The Alzheimer's Disease Therapeutic Research Institute (http://atri.usc.edu/) is seeking postdoctoral scholars interested in modelling the long-term biomarker dynamics of Alzheimer's disease with the aim of informing clinical trial design. The project involves latent trait models for multidimensional longitudinal data, and preliminary work has been implemented in rstan.

We are an institute of the University of Southern California based in San Diego that coordinates clinical trials and natural history studies such as the Anti-Amyloid Treatment in Asymptomatic Alzheimer’s (A4) and Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) studies.

For more info, and to apply:

http://jobs.usc.edu/postings/65952
http://jobs.usc.edu/postings/65954

Many thanks,

Mike

--
